description: PLANO MUNICIPAL DE MOBLIDADE ELÉTRICA is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Município de Velas. Velas Municipal Electric Mobility Plan, with the aim of preparing the Municipality for the energy transition in the area of mobility, defining the phases of growth and consolidation of electric mobility in the municipality. Coverage: Município de Velas. The portal shows the English title as "MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC MOBILITY PLAN" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Município de Velas. Its keywords include plano, velas-sao-jorge, mobilidade-eletrica, plano-municipal-mobilidade-eletrica, velas. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2025-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
